about: Acks fields in the counted layout: the count less one, the roster indexes as a list or bitmap, then one little-endian Idx64 per member. Generated by scripts/gen_acks_vectors.py from katzenqt's Python codec (ack_codec.py). Each valid case lists (roster index, Idx64) pairs in the order the sender was given them. Lenient fields are accepted by the spec's parser but never written by the encoder; malformed fields are refused.
